R: cyclohexene structure with a C1=C6 double bond, CH₃ on C1, OH and CH₃ on C3, and CH₂OH on C4.
items.stem_lead: What is the major product formed when compound R is warmed with an excess of HBr?

options.A: Cyclohexane product with Br and CH₃ on C1, Br and CH₃ on C3, and CH₂Br on C4.
options.B: Cyclohexane product with CH₃ on C1, Br on C6, OH and CH₃ on C3, and CH₂Br on C4.
options.C: Cyclohexane product with Br and CH₃ on C1, OH and CH₃ on C3, and CH₂OH on C4.
options.D: Cyclohexane product with CH₃ on C1, Br on C6, Br and CH₃ on C3, and CH₂Br on C4.

items.stem:
The structure of santonin is shown.

Santonin is first treated with warm dilute H₂SO₄. The product of this reaction is treated with cold dilute acidified KMnO₄. A final product, Q, is obtained.

How many atoms of hydrogen in each molecule of product Q will react with sodium metal?
